revision.trazadoAyuda: This nerve is not in the scanned model: it was traced over model structures (arteries, bronchi, oesophagus) following the sources of this entry. Look at it in 3D, dotted, and say whether the course is correct or what you would change.

revision.seccion_grupos: Limbic system, basal ganglia, diencephalon and brainstem

guia.intro: Thank you for reviewing Maysa Brain. Everything you see is as students would see it; your part is to say what is right and what you would change. Nothing is published as verified without a teacher's approval.
guia.responder: In each entry, under each field, there are three buttons: Correct, Suggest a fix (write the change, with its source if you have one) and Not my field. You can leave a comment. To remove an answer, press the same button again. Everything is saved only in this browser.
guia.idiomas: Fields are reviewed in the language you are viewing: to review the English version, press EN in the header (and ES for the Spanish one); you stay in review mode and on the same entry.
guia.dudas: Some entries carry an "Open question for you": a specific question left by the writing. Answering it helps the most.
guia.nombres: If a name has no official term in Spanish or Latin, the entry shows the proposal and its source: confirm or correct it.
guia.marcadores: Markers are structures without a 3D mesh. If the position is approximate or missing, use "Propose position" and tap the point on the model.
guia.trazos: The vagus branches come as unnamed strands. In this mode, tapping a strand asks you which branch it is.
guia.recorridos: The recurrent laryngeal nerves and the left vagus below the thorax are not in the scanned model: they were traced and appear dotted. In their entry, "Traced course" asks for your judgement.
guia.enviar: Whenever you want, press "Send review": a prefilled form opens for each entry; just press Submit at the end. You can send as many times as you like.
guia.privacidad: Before your first review, register once: the name you want shown, your role and your consent (Colombian Law 1581 of 2012). Your name only appears on the entries you validate.

aviso.educativo: Educational use. Not a clinical or diagnostic tool.
aviso.unCuerpo: The model represents a single adult male body; anatomy varies between people.
aviso.borrador: This is a pilot version: cards are drafts until teachers review them.
